questions.subject: Maths
questions.prompt: A triangle has a base of 21 cm and a height of 8 cm. Work through it calmly: what is its area?
questions.why: Area = ½ × base × height = ½ × 21 × 8 = 84 cm². Halving is the step to slow down and check.
